conflicts.name: OpenWhisper
conflicts.detail: The previous product name OpenWhisper conflicted with an independently maintained macOS speech-to-text application that publishes release artifacts. The product was renamed to VibeWhisper to exit that collision; VibeWhisper still needs a fresh trademark/domain/App Store/GitHub audit before public distribution.

decision: Product code and packaging now use VibeWhisper. Do not publish notarized stable updates, public domains, or marketplace listings until a fresh clearance pass marks this file approved with all checks true and no active conflicts for the VibeWhisper name.
